summary: Phase 8 - Avatar Seçimi (avatar picker) module. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS covering /api/avatar/config, seeded concepts list (4 concepts: Hayvanlar/Robotlar/Klasik with null inherited audience + Yönetici Özel with titles=[Yönetici,Direktör], each 12 DiceBear avatars), concept CRUD (create with count clamp 20->15, add avatar, remove avatar, update name/audience/status, delete), audience feed (Erol Taş/Uzman excluded from 'Yönetici Özel'; Selin Tekin/Yönetici includes it; unknown employee -> 404), avatar selection persistence via GET /api/employees, unlimited change (re-select overrides), avatar_report (per-concept counts + total_selected/total_employees), and /api/categories smoke (avatar type present, 6 active types). Frontend E2E via Playwright with localStorage pln_role/pln_emp driven flows: (Employee) discovery page shows 'Avatar Seçimi' card; /ic-iletisim/avatar renders exactly 3 concept tabs for non-manager (Hayvanlar/Robotlar/Klasik — 'Yönetici Özel' correctly hidden); switching tabs shows 12 avatar-opt tiles; clicking an avatar selects it (avatar-current preview updates); Kaydet persists (nav-avatar reflects DiceBear URL identical to selection); page reload shows same avatar as current (persistence + unlimited re-selection confirmed). Manager (Selin Tekin) sees all 4 tabs including 'Yönetici Özel'. (Admin) /admin -> Avatar Seçimi tab (admin-tab-avatar) lists 4 concept-row items with cover/name/'Aktif' badge/'12 avatar' badge and 'Üstten miras' audience label for the 3 inherited concepts (Yönetici Özel shows 'Hedef: Yönetici, Direktör'); Popülerlik report renders concept-count bars; add-concept dialog creates TEST_UI_Concept with inherit=default checked (12 avatars generated); gallery expand shows avatar-add-<id>; edit updates name to TEST_UI_Concept2; delete removes the row. Cleanup: TEST_UI_Concept2 deleted (no residual test data).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1388 lines — well above 700-line guideline. Splitting into modules (avatar.py, listings.py, mood.py, etc.) is overdue but non-blocking.
gen_avatars() generates URLs with a random suffix (new_id()[:8]) — collision extremely unlikely but avatar identity is by full URL string, which is fine for MongoDB $push/$pull semantics used here.
avatar_report matches by exact URL string; if concept avatars are ever regenerated the historical selections could orphan. Acceptable for current MVP.
POST /api/avatar/concepts/{cid}/remove takes a plain dict payload; consider a Pydantic model (RemoveAvatarPayload) for validation consistency. Non-blocking.

concepts_feed does not fall back gracefully if the avatar category is missing (cat is None) — inherited audience becomes None and matches all, which is the current desired behavior; just noting for future changes.
test_credentials: None — mock role switcher; localStorage pln_role ('admin'|'employee') + pln_emp drive flows. Clearing pln_emp before employee tests confirmed to avoid stale-id 404 (AppContext refreshEmployees validates stale ids).
seed_data_creation: Playwright admin flow created TEST_UI_Concept -> renamed to TEST_UI_Concept2 -> deleted. No residual test data. Backend test suite created TEST_Concept/TEST_Clamp and deleted both at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression files under /app/backend/tests: backend_test.py, test_event_report.py, test_events_compare.py, test_listings.py, test_mood.py, test_pulses.py, test_avatar.py (new). Run all with: pytest /app/backend/tests -v. Frontend E2E pattern: set localStorage pln_role, optionally pln_emp, then navigate — reliable across all modules. Non-blocking nit from iter7 (duplicate 'ilan' key in CATEGORY_TYPES) still not fixed but harmless.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in Phase 8.
